title: A session that repeats a track, adds a track and adds a via
how: Unit: 1000 in `resolution um 1000` is one nanometre. The first wire is the track that the board already has (same layer, same width, same two points): left out and counted in already_there = 1;
the second wire runs from (20, 10) to (20, 15) mm on Top: 1 new track of length 5 mm = 5000000 nm (a vertical piece, so no square root);
the via is at (25, 5) mm with the size of the vias of the board: 1 new via;
all on net A, which the board has. After the plan is applied the file for the autorouter counts 1 + 1 = 2 tracks and 2 + 1 = 3 vias.
